content.short: Eth Tester is a Python-built tool suite for testing Ethereum smart contracts.
content.description: Eth Tester is a Python-based tool suite for testing Ethereum smart contracts. It provides a comprehensive library of testing tools, functions, and standards that apply to any smart contract on the Ethereum blockchain. Developers can invoke test functions with a single command, or add the package to their projects to run the full suite of tests as part of their CI/CD pipelines. The suite is designed to streamline contract validation, enabling consistent, repeatable testing across environments.
